rv.q: While their initial awkwardness felt appropriate as the characters grew more familiar, the spark never really intensified.
It’s a sweet conclusion to a show whose mediocre book doesn't measure up to its musical potential.
And at Oil Lamp Theater, where the audience is close enough to catch every expression and every laugh, I Love You Because becomes an especially inviting night out.
"I Love You Because" might just be the way to show your children what is out there today.

cn.t: This romantic musical about modern dating earns praise for its pretty vocals and relatable exploration of love's complications, though critics note the book itself is mediocre and hampers the production's potential.
